name: Pipeliners - SEO GEO AEO Audit Tempe Buckeye Florence 2026-08-31
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-08-31

# Summary
A Word report "SEO / GEO / AEO Audit Report, Full Audit: Tempe, Buckeye, Florence" dated Aug 31, 2026, produced with an SEO audit skill. It also looked at /services-areas/, /about-us/, /free-sewer-inspection/ and robots.txt.

# Key findings
- Scores: SEO 6/10, GEO 7/10, AEO 7/10 (combined 20/30).
- The three city pages are technically sound (about 5,200 to 5,600 words each, one H1, Plumber + LocalBusiness schema, 8 to 11 localized FAQs) and already ranked: 77 keywords across the site sat at positions 4 to 10.
- They earned zero clicks: 2,564 impressions over 89 days and no non-brand clicks. The failure is in the search listing, not the page.
- Proof on the same site: /free-sewer-inspection/ ranked around position 62 yet had about 1.9% CTR because its meta ended with a phone number and call to action.
- All three titles were misaligned with measured demand (Tempe omitted "Line" while 903 impressions came from "sewer line repair"), and every page's title contradicted its own og:title. Buckeye had no brand token.
- GEO: strong local specificity but no author or source citations. AEO: excellent FAQ layer but no direct-answer block above the fold.

# Decisions and status
- Recommendation: rewrite nine fields (3 titles, 3 metas, 3 og:titles), covering 63% of the striking-distance opportunity. Deployed the same day (see the rewrites note).
- A lock file (`~$...docx`) in the folder is an Office temp file, not content.
